finding_text: Fo llowing a confirmed Bacillus thuringtensis contamination in biore actor redacted (b)(4) for Soliris lot redacted (b)(4) on July 18, 2012, the decontamination of bioreactor redacted (b)(4) was executed, followed by a routine CIP cycle.

finding_text: The collection of overweight units of whole blood was addressed during the April-June 2002 and September-January 2006 FDA inspections of this region.

finding_text: SOP QC-033.00, Facility Bioburden, section 9.1.3 requires that "All environmental isolates are sent out for identification, including alert and action level samples, routine bioburden samples, media fill samples and Class 100 samples, shall be identified to the species-level".
finding_text_ko: SOP QC-033.00, Facility Bioburden, 9.1.3항은 경보·조치 수준 검체, 일상 생균수 검체, 미디어 필 검체 및 Class 100 검체를 포함한 모든 환경 분리균을 종 수준까지 동정하기 위해 외부로 보내야 한다고 요구합니다.

finding_text: QA failed to perform a thorough assessment of this problém in a timely manner.

finding_text: Laboratory controls do not include the establishment of scientifically sound and appropriate test procedures designed to assure that drug products conform to appropriate standards of identity, strength, quality and purity.
